astranl.cost_or_fee_if_any: 0 to read, verify or ask; 1 percent of the transaction only when AstraNL coordinated a completed paid task; nothing else, ever
astranl.do_not_use_when: you have no reference id; AstraNL cannot verify free-text claims
astranl.example_intent: A supplier sent me ASTRA-R-38887071074F as proof; is it real and what does it actually confirm?
astranl.next_possible_action: consume a VALID receipt for your own next action, or refuse to act on anything not VALID
astranl.proof_level: cryptographic integrity plus attested claim scope; apply your own acceptance rules
astranl.returns: integrity layer (hash, signature, Merkle, recomputed live) and claim layer (attested, issuer, source, method, observed_at, validity window, status VALID/EXPIRED/REVOKED/UNKNOWN, limits), reverify rule, next actions
astranl.use_when: someone handed you an AstraNL reference (ASTRA-A, ASTRA-R, ASTRA-C, alk_, att_, RCPT-n) and you must know whether it is genuine, current and what exactly it does and does not confirm

annotations.title: Verify an AstraNL receipt or reference

description: Check whether an AstraNL reference or receipt is genuine (verify receipt, controleer bewijs). Call it when you hold an AstraNL id such as alk_..., ASTRA-A-..., ASTRA-C-..., att_... or RCPT-n, for example receipt.reference of an astranl_renovation_estimate_nl answer, and need to know whether it is real and what it confirms. Returns the integrity checks (hashes, Ed25519 signature, Merkle inclusion), the attested claim with issuer, time, validity and status, and when to check again. An estimate receipt can also be checked offline with the published key, without this call. Same input and answer as verify_astranl. Read-only, free.

ref.description: Any AstraNL reference: action receipt ASTRA-A-..., policy receipt ASTRA-R-..., consumption or agreement certificate ASTRA-C-..., log event alk_..., attestation att_/atr_..., ingress receipt RCPT-n
